sample_size.excerpt: Suitable quantity and quality of genomic DNA was obtained from a subset of 777 (70.8%) eligible RCC cases and 1035 (70.1%) controls enrolled in our study.
sample_size.location: Abstract, paragraph 1; total_n derived from reported group counts 777 + 1035 = 1812

cases.excerpt: Therefore, we investigated whether VDR and RXRA polymorphisms modify associations between RCC risk and frequency of dietary intake of vitamin D and calcium rich foods, and occupational ultraviolet exposure among 777 RCC case and 1035 controls from Central and Eastern Europe.

comparison.excerpt: A positive association was observed in this population between increasing dietary intake frequency of yogurt

design.excerpt: a hospital-based case-control study of RCC was conducted

timing.excerpt: then extrapolated to represent lifetime average dietary intake

exposure_measurement.excerpt: Frequency of dietary intake variables categorized into tertiles based on intake among genotyped controls.
